_help: Life and action skills (scripts/LifeSkills.cs, focus F-24/F-25; .devloop/systems/stats.md 'life' stage). Every skill levels with use: XP needed from level L to L+1 = round(base x L^growth), up to max. perLevel: stat-table keys added per level past 1, applied through the stat pipeline's life stage (gem 'life_<id>' keys add levels). soft: XP per minute before diminishing returns (an award is scaled by soft / (soft + XP already gained in the last 60 s)). group: life (crafts and trades) or action (what you do with your body). Distance skills: 'per' metres of real movement (measured from the hero's position, never from keys) give 'xp'; teleports and steps over 'maxStep' metres in one frame count nothing.

lockedChests._help: A-10: this share of the treasure chests in the world and the dungeons is locked (picked with a lockpick, Interact); a locked chest gives 'bonus' times the loot; 'diff' = lock difficulty 0..1 (narrower sweet spot).

mining.desc: Digging blocks and mining ore veins and crystals.
mining.perk: digs faster; a chance of an extra drop or a gem

fishing.perk: a wider reel zone; rarer catches (counts as extra fishing levels in the loot tables)

cooking.desc: Cooking recipes at a campfire or a cooking station.
cooking.perk: stronger and longer food buffs; a chance of a double portion

herbalism.perk: gathers faster; a chance of one more

woodcutting.desc: Chopping fallen logs and wooden blocks.
woodcutting.perk: chops faster; a chance of one more

crafting.desc: Making blocks, tools and gear in the crafting window.
crafting.perk: a chance to get one material back

farming.desc: Tilling soil, planting seeds, harvesting ripe crops and tending livestock (scripts/Farm.cs, data/farm.json).
farming.perk: a chance of extra produce at harvest; crops grow faster

smithing.desc: Honing gear with Dorrin the smith.
smithing.perk: Dorrin asks less gold to hone

lockpicking.desc: Picking locked doors and chests that are not yours.
lockpicking.perk: a wider sweet spot; picks hold longer under strain

jumping.desc: Jumps that cover ground or reach higher ground (not hopping in place).

walking.perk: move a little faster; stamina refills faster

running.perk: sprinting costs less stamina; more stamina

swimming.perk: swim faster; hold your breath longer

creeping.desc: Sneaking close to monsters that have not noticed you.
creeping.perk: monsters notice you from less far while you sneak

riding.desc: Distance ridden on a horse or a pet.

blocking.desc: Monster blows blocked or parried with a shield.
blocking.perk: blocks soak more of a blow
